LESSON: SELECTED VERSES

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Qur’an
Topic 1.3: Selected verses

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Selected verses. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How can the teachings of the verses reform the society?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read the selected verses correctly for spiritual nourishment
2. explain the meaning of the selected verses to ease application
3. explain the teachings of the selected verses for character building

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. read the selected verses correctly for spiritual nourishment
   In simple words: practise until you can read the selected verses correctly for spiritual nourishment. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. explain the meaning of the selected verses to ease application
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the meaning of the selected verses to ease application. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. explain the teachings of the selected verses for character building
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the teachings of the selected verses for character building. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Selected verses using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Selected verses in the examples.
2. Explain Selected verses to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Selected verses.
4. Show that you can: read the selected verses correctly for spiritual nourishment

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Selected verses using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Selected verses important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read the selected verses from the Qur’an,
2. Discuss the meaning of the selected verses and make class presentations,
3. Listen to a resource person explaining the lessons from the selected verses and make notes,
4. Critical thinking and problem solving: the skill of interpretation and inference is enhanced when learners research online on the teachings of the selected verses, deduce lessons and make notes.
5. Social cohesion is promoted as learners discuss the meaning of the selected verses in groups and make class presentations.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read the selected verses correctly for spiritual nourishment
2. explain the meaning of the selected verses to ease application
3. explain the teachings of the selected verses for character building

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
